On Wed, Nov 18, 2026 at 08:23 AM Alicia Gomez <agomez@spectra-supply.com> wrote:
> We clicked the invitation link you sent yesterday (Coupa invite) and it redirected us to our Okta SSO as expected. After signing in, instead of landing on the supplier activation checklist we get an error page: "Activation token not recognized / tenant mismatch".

Quick update from diagnostics I ran against the activation flow (captures attached). Summary: the SAML response is coming back with the correct user attributes, but the RelayState contains an org_id that points to an internal staging alias (SpectraCorp) instead of the Spectra Supply production tenant. When the activation service resolves the token it looks up the tenant by that org_id and fails to match the customer's real tenant.

Evidence: I pulled the SSO event logs and a short debug extract (attached).

Workaround (short-term): I can create a one-time manual tenant binding link that bypasses the RelayState tenant lookup and validates the activation token directly against Spectra Supply. That link will be single-use and expire in 24 hours.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Provide Alicia the one-time link so they can complete activation now.
2) I'll open an internal ticket (PROV-4421) to push a fix: validate RelayState mapping and add a fallback tenant-disambiguation step.
3) If Coupa has any tenant-map caching on their side, we may need their support to flush the alias mapping.

Attachments:
- saml-debug-20261118.txt (text/plain) — extracted RelayState and SAML assertion snippets
- sso-event-20261118.log (text/plain) — server-side event trace (redacted PII)

Ben Carter
Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference

Hi Alicia — quick follow-up with a temporary path forward.

Ben confirmed this looks like a RelayState -> tenant alias mismatch. We've generated a one-time activation link that should let Spectra Supply finish the supplier onboarding without reworking your Okta configuration. Please follow these steps:

1) Use a private/incognito window.
2) Paste this link into the browser (one-time use): https://portal.redwood.com/activate/one-time/6f9b-activatelink (expires in 24h).
3) Sign in via your normal Okta flow when prompted. If you land on an error, take a screenshot of the browser URL + page and send back to us.

If that succeeds we'll complete your PO setup and notify procurement teams. If it fails, we'll escalate to Coupa Support and share the saml-debug logs (we'll include the trace).

I've also attached a short mutual action plan and the onboarding spreadsheet so you can confirm required fields we need to push the first PO.

Apologies for the interruption — Ben's logging PROV-4421 to fix the mapping. I'll update HUB-12943 and follow up once we've verified the permanent fix.
